# Test dependencies for openframe-adapters local development
#
# CI does NOT use this file — each package's own app-test.yml matrix row
# installs that package's dev extras directly (pip install -e ".[dev]"),
# isolated per package. This file exists purely as a local-dev convenience
# shortcut for running every adapter's tests in one shared environment from
# the repo root, without entering each package directory one at a time:
#   pip install -r .github/requirements/test.txt
#   pytest packages/
#
# Keep in sync with every package's pyproject.toml when adding a package or
# bumping a runtime dependency floor — nothing enforces this automatically.

# ── Test runner ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pytest>=8.0
pytest-asyncio>=0.23
pytest-mock>=3.14

# ── Adapter runtime deps ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Pinned at minimum supported floors — mirrors each adapter's pyproject.toml.
# Where two packages share a driver (mysql/mariadb → aiomysql,
# postgres/cockroachdb → asyncpg), the floor is listed once.

# openframe-adapters-db-postgres / -db-cockroachdb
asyncpg>=0.29

# openframe-adapters-db-mongo
motor>=3.3
pymongo>=4.6

# openframe-adapters-db-redis
redis>=5.0

# openframe-adapters-db-mysql / -db-mariadb
aiomysql>=0.2

# openframe-adapters-db-oracle
oracledb>=2.0

# openframe-adapters-db-dynamodb
aioboto3>=13.0

# openframe-adapters-db-cassandra
cassandra-driver>=3.29

# openframe-adapters-db-influxdb
influxdb-client[async]>=1.40

# openframe-adapters-db-qdrant
qdrant-client>=1.9

# openframe-adapters-db-milvus
pymilvus>=2.5

# openframe-adapters-db-chromadb
chromadb>=0.5,<2

# openframe-adapters-db-falkordb
falkordb>=1.7,<2

# openframe-adapters-queue-kafka
aiokafka>=0.11

# openframe-adapters-queue-nats
nats-py>=2.7

# openframe-adapters-queue-rabbitmq
aio-pika>=9.4

# ── Shared transitive dep ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# openframe-core is a direct dependency of every adapter package. Pinned
# here at the STRICTEST floor among all packages (falkordb/qdrant/milvus/
# chromadb need BaseGraphStore/BaseVectorStore, only present from 3.5+/3.6+)
# — older packages' own looser floors (e.g. postgres's >=3.3,<4) are still
# satisfied by anything >=3.6,<4, so this does not understate what any
# individual package actually requires.
openframe-core>=3.6,<4
